Precomputes byte strides v13 = 4 * a5 (extra conditional stride) and v14 = 4 * a8 (base per-iteration stride).
Stores the fill value a7 into result and into the current write pointer *v9.
Advances the write pointer by the base stride v14 (4 * a8 bytes).
Tests the sign of the error accumulator a1: when negative it is incremented by a3; otherwise it is incremented by a4 and the write pointer is advanced an extra v13 (4 * a5) bytes.
Decrements the counter a2 each iteration and repeats until a2 reaches zero.
Returns the stored fill value a7 (result).
